verdict.rationale: Ramp ships a documented Developer API (an OpenAPI spec with 174 paths) and exposes accounting data through its own surfaces. The CLI has an accounting resource, the MCP server publishes accounting:read and accounting:write scopes, and the Banking API returns transactions available to sync to an accounting provider. However, the evidence never documents dedicated Developer API accounting endpoints such as GL accounts, accounting categories or sync status. missing for 10: explicit documentation of Developer API accounting endpoints (GL accounts, categories, sync management), write/manage operations on accounting data via the REST API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view and manage accounting data through a dedicated API

citations.quote: Ramp also supports custom CSV exports and an open API for flexible connectivity.
